controls: Reuse v2 splits, hash cohorts, frozen pre-March statistics, all retrieval channels, candidates, training queries and LambdaRank parameters. Never inject targets; no model selection or hyperparameter search.
limitations: Ranking-side ablation only: even behavior-only ranking uses an attribute-aware fixed retrieval pool; attribute ranks break ties with frozen purchase popularity.
April has already been evaluated and informed this study. It is development evidence, not a fresh independent test.
Full-feature model is the existing frozen v2 booster; its predictions must exactly reproduce every saved top-100 list.
Diagnostic target-popularity groups use the purchased target for post-hoc analysis only, not model input or cohort selection.
Single seed and sampled cohorts. Differences do not establish population-level or online business gains.
